title: fix-animation-finished-frame: spawn/merge/slide end events were silently lost
description:
Second demo bug discovered after PR #5: all three :ui/animation-finished dispatches in views/board.cljs (on-merge-end, on-slide-end, ensure-spawn-timeout!) fire from outside the React render context (animationend / transitionend / setTimeout) so without {:frame :game} they default to :rf/default where no handler is registered. Net effect: animation queues in :ui.animation never drain → :sub/animation-busy? stuck true → every :input/key-down silently dropped on the §6.3 gate → keyboard appears dead.

Confirmed via console diagnosis: handle_keydown ran cleanly but :ui.animation.spawns still held the original boot-spawned tiles even after the manual dispatch_sync [:game/new] reset.

FIX: add {:frame :game} to all three rf/dispatch calls in board.cljs.

GENERAL PATTERN (to fold into spec v0.4): every non-React-context dispatch (raw DOM listeners, setTimeout, Promise.then, async callbacks, etc.) MUST pass {:frame :game} explicitly. The frame-provider in the view tree only sets the frame via React context, which doesn't bind outside the render cycle. Spec §4.4 should call this out, or the codebase should introduce a project-local game-dispatch wrapper that always supplies :frame.

title: fix-input-frame: dispatch :input/key-down into :game frame
description:
Demo bug surfaced during operator review of PR #4: keyboard input is silently no-op because input/handle-keydown dispatches without {:frame :game}, routing the event to re-frame2's default frame instead of the application's :game frame where the handler is registered. Compare to core.cljs line 100 (the :app/initialise dispatch-sync) which correctly passes {:frame :game}.

FIX: in src/reframe_2048_2/input.cljs, change line 52 from
  (rf/dispatch [:input/key-down {:key k}])
to
  (rf/dispatch [:input/key-down {:key k}] {:frame :game})

DEVIATION FROM MAYOR METHOD: applied directly in mayor session rather than dispatched to a worker because (a) the change is one line, (b) was surfaced during operator review at the demo gate, (c) dispatching ~60k tokens of worker overhead for ~12 chars of code is disproportionate. Recorded here for traceability.
notes: Merged via PR #5. Keyboard dispatch now correctly routes to :game frame.

title: impl-views: Reagent views, palette, animations — the demo bead
description:

SCOPE (this bead only):

- src/reframe_2048_2/views/header.cljs — title, current score, best score, 'New Game' button (dispatches :game/new)
- src/reframe_2048_2/views/board.cljs — 4×4 cell grid + absolutely-positioned tile vnodes. Each tile vnode MUST carry ^{:key (:id tile)} so React preserves the DOM node across slides
- src/reframe_2048_2/views/overlay.cljs — won and over overlays; won has Continue + New Game buttons; over has New Game button. Trap keyboard focus when shown (§8.1)
- src/reframe_2048_2/views/footer.cljs — one-paragraph instruction including the §6.1 key map

Wire-up:
- Update src/reframe_2048_2/core.cljs to mount app-view at #app (replace the existing placeholder Hello div)
- Trigger :game/new on app boot so the first frame has two spawned tiles

Styling:
- public/css/style.css with the canonical §8.2 palette VERBATIM (every hex in the spec's tile table, plus chrome colours and empty-cell rgba)
- Animations per §8.3: spawn 0→1 scale ≤200ms (MUST), merge pulse to 1.1× ≤250ms (MUST), slide translate ≤200ms ease-out (SHOULD). Hook to dispatch :ui/animation-finished from CSS transitionend (slide, merge) and setTimeout (spawn).
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce MUST set slide and merge durations to 0ms
- Responsive: board must fit viewport on devices ≥320px wide
- WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (≥ 4.5:1) on tile text — the canonical palette mostly already achieves this; verify with a tool / cite

A11y wiring (§8.4):
- Mount an ARIA live region (aria-live='polite') in app-view; subscribe to :sub/phase changes and to a debounced score-changed announcement; render via :fx/announce effect (handler updates the DOM live region)
- Board container is keyboard-focusable; arrow keys MUST work whenever document has focus, not just when an element does (the global :input/key-down listener installed by impl-state already handles this — just verify in views)
- Tile numeric value MUST be visible (text content of the tile vnode)

Linkage:
- Update public/index.html to link the new css

OUT OF SCOPE: CI bundle-grep for tracing strip (deferred to impl-trace-define bead). Test fixture replay corpus beyond what impl-state already shipped. Touch input (NG7). Theming alternatives (NG3). Localisation (NG6).

ACCEPTANCE:
- 'npx shadow-cljs compile app' green, 'npx shadow-cljs compile test' green.
- App at localhost:8080 is a playable canonical-looking 2048: header with score + best-score, 4×4 board, tiles slide/merge on arrow keys, score increments, win overlay at 2048 with Continue, game-over overlay when stuck, New Game resets.
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce strips slide and merge animations (test by toggling the OS setting or a devtools emulation).
- Mayor verifies the demo manually (npm install + shadow-cljs watch + open browser) and confirms before review with operator.
- PR opened against main.

Closed via PR #4 (https://github.com/coltnz/2048-reframe-2/pull/4). impl-views landed: header/board/overlay/footer per §4.7; canonical §8.2 palette verbatim in public/css/style.css; §8.3 animations (spawn 180ms, merge 220ms, slide 180ms); prefers-reduced-motion zeros slide+merge; ARIA live region wired to :fx/announce. title: impl-state: app-db, schemas, events, subs, effects, FSM
description:
Wire up the re-frame2 state layer from spec §4-§7. This is the largest impl bead — it consumes the mechanics ns (PR #2, src/reframe_2048_2/mechanics.cljs) and exposes the surface that the views bead will subscribe to.

SCOPE (this bead only):

Namespaces to create:
- src/reframe_2048_2/schemas.cljs — every Malli schema from spec §5.2 verbatim (30+ schemas: Cell, Direction, Phase, AnimationPhase, Tile, all Event-*, Fx-*, Sub-*, Anim-*, AppDb-Game, AppDb-UI, AppDb-Input, AppDb, StorageBlob-BestScore).
- src/reframe_2048_2/db.cljs — initial-db value matching the §5.1 shape; default :rng-seed taken from (.now js/Date) on :game/new (or fixture seed in tests).
- src/reframe_2048_2/events.cljs — every reg-event-db / reg-event-fx from §4.4: :game/new, :game/move, :game/continue, :game/dismiss-over, :input/key-down, :storage/loaded, :storage/save, :ui/animation-finished. Use Malli validation in dev. The :game/move handler MUST delegate to mechanics/slide, mechanics/spawn, mechanics/legal-moves, mechanics/won-after-move? per spec §3-§4.4.
- src/reframe_2048_2/subs.cljs — every reg-sub from §4.6: :sub/board, :sub/tiles, :sub/score, :sub/best-score, :sub/phase, :sub/legal-moves, :sub/animation-busy?. Derivations per §4.6 table.
- src/reframe_2048_2/effects.cljs — every reg-fx from §4.5: :fx/storage-write, :fx/storage-read, :fx/focus, :fx/announce. localStorage failure fallback per §7.1.
- src/reframe_2048_2/fsm.cljs — reg-machine for the §4.8 transitions table including the 'Ignored (state, event) pairs' rule. :game/new from any state goes directly to :playing (single-step per spec §4.8).
- src/reframe_2048_2/input.cljs — :input/key-down handler that translates DOM key strings to game events per §6.1 (including Enter/c/C → :game/continue and Escape → :game/dismiss-over). MUST short-circuit when :sub/animation-busy? is true.
- Update src/reframe_2048_2/core.cljs to require all the above and to install a window keydown listener that dispatches :input/key-down. Still no real views — placeholder view remains until impl-views.

Tests to add:
- test/reframe_2048_2/events_test.cljs — at least one test per reg-event-* per spec §9.2. RNG injected via initial seed.
- test/reframe_2048_2/fsm_test.cljs — the §4.8 transitions table, plus ignored-event no-ops.
- test/reframe_2048_2/integration_test.cljs — one win-game trace and one lose-game trace as per §9.3.

OUT OF SCOPE: Reagent views beyond the existing placeholder (those land in impl-views next bead), animation polish, accessibility wiring beyond the :fx/announce/:fx/focus implementations, the test fixture replay corpus beyond the two basic traces.

ACCEPTANCE:

- App still mounts to localhost:8080 (placeholder view).

Merged as PR #3. 209,530 tokens / 25 min. Surfaced 5 spec defects (filed as reframe-2048-3sl for v0.4).

title: impl-mechanics: pure 2048 game-rule functions
description:
Add a new CLJS namespace src/reframe_2048_2/mechanics.cljs containing the pure-function core of §3 (game rules) and §5.3 (RNG). No re-frame integration in this bead — only pure data-in / data-out fns.

SCOPE (this bead only):
- src/reframe_2048_2/mechanics.cljs containing:
  - next-seed [s] — xorshift32 per spec §5.3; returns [new-seed random-int32]. Seed MUST NOT be 0 (replace with 1 if so).
  - traversals-for [dir] — returns {:rows v :cols v} per the §3.5 step-1 table.
  - slide [tiles dir dims] — given a map-by-id of tiles, a direction, and [rows cols] dims, return {:tiles new-tiles :score-delta n :slides [...] :merges [...]}. Implements the §3.5 algorithm including the !mergedFrom guard.
  - empty-cells [tiles dims] — vector of [row col] cells with no tile.
  - spawn [tiles seed dims next-id] — invokes next-seed twice per §5.3 (cell choice, value choice); returns {:tiles tiles' :seed seed' :spawns [...] :next-id next-id'}.
  - legal-move? [tiles dir dims] — true iff resolving §3.5 in dir against tiles would be a successful move.
  - legal-moves [tiles dims] — set of dirs where legal-move? is true.
  - game-over? [tiles dims] — (empty? (legal-moves tiles dims)).
  - won-after-move? [merges] — true iff any of the merge events produced a tile of value 2048.

- test/reframe_2048_2/mechanics_test.cljs with the §9.1 canonical cases plus a few §9.4 invariants:
  - [2 2 2 2] left → [4 4 _ _], score +8
  - [2 2 4 _] left → [4 4 _ _]
  - [4 4 2 2] left → [8 4 _ _]
  - [2 _ 2 4] left → [4 4 _ _]
  - full immobile board → game-over?
  - spawn is deterministic given a fixed seed
  - P(value=2) over many spawns is ≈ 0.9 with bounded statistical tolerance
- Update :test build wiring (if needed) so 'npx shadow-cljs compile test' runs these cleanly.

OUT OF SCOPE: re-frame integration (events, subs, fx), Reagent views, app-db structure, persistence, animation, FSM. Those are later beads.

ACCEPTANCE:
- 'npx shadow-cljs compile app' green; 'npx shadow-cljs compile test' green.
- All listed tests pass.
- mechanics.cljs has zero re-frame / Reagent / DOM references.
- PR opened against main.

title: spec-v0.4: fold 5 implementation-discovered defects
description:
v0.3 audit deferred D-06..D-09 per operator no-pedantry redirect. Implementation surfaced 6 additional spec defects (1 in PR #2 mechanics, 5 in PR #3 state). Fold all of these into v0.4 after the demo gate.

From PR #2 (mechanics, reframe-2048-w9e):
- A. slide signature should be [tiles dir dims next-id] not [tiles dir dims] — §3.5 step 3 requires a fresh id per merge, which the caller can't supply otherwise.

From PR #3 (state, reframe-2048-z0b):
- B. Event-StorageLoaded schema (§5.2) is map-shaped but :fx/storage-read (§4.5) dispatches a bare parsed value. Reconcile.
- C. §4.8 reg-machine — mechanics-aware outcome flags don't fit pure-data guards. Worker registered the machine for documentation and used a shared transition-table data structure dispatched from event handlers. The §4.8 'substitute MUST justify in a spec amendment' clause demands this be folded in.
- D. re-frame2 alpha monorepo needs :exclusions [day8/re-frame2] on sub-artefacts so clj resolves a single core checkout. Worth a §10 note.
- E. reset-frame-db! is not in re-frame2 alpha; an :app/initialise reg-event-fx is the equivalent. Describe the boot event explicitly in §4.4.
- F. re-frame2.config/TRACE-ENABLED closure-define is MUST in §10 but goog.DEBUG already handles the practical strip. Either keep the closure-define + CI grep (tracked as separate bead ) or amend §10 to acknowledge goog.DEBUG as a host-equivalent substitute.

From v0.2 audit (deferred):
- D-06..D-09 — minor wire-shape under-specifications. Re-evaluate post-demo.

ACCEPTANCE: /ai/specs/2048-reframe-2.md at v0.4 with §12.1 revision-history entry; all 6 implementation defects + the 4 deferred audit defects addressed (either inline fix or explicit host-choice paragraph per re-frame2 SA-4).
